scope: Actual linked transfer owner/native receiver/UI/storage/UARTISR; hardware FIFO/ports/BIOS ticks+keys/video and DOS filesystem kernel only modeled. No product callback patched, skipped or substituted.
limitations: Synthetic CRC128/1024/mixed/empty peers; not full protocol or actual DOS/physical modem proof.
Synthetic clock advances one BIOSdaytick per eight clock reads; IRQ and busy-loop timing is modeled, and deadlines are checked using actual full daytick arithmetic.
